desc:
CAT WARS is a fast-paced third person arena shooter! Master smooth movement, outplay your opponents, and battle in chaotic Arena matches or competitive Duels!

⌛ VERSION 1.6! HALLOWS 2026 🎃

🔫 Master movement and gunplay in Arena & Duels!
🐈 Level up to unlock new cats and weapons!
👥 Challenge friends or battle other players!
🪙 Complete quests and earn rewards!

🎮 Available on PC, Mobile, Xbox & PlayStation!

⚠️ BETA: You may encounter bugs. Cheating results in a permanent ban.
